passages.title: Digital Safety: The Game Reward Message
passages.text: Rafi was playing an online game when a message appeared in the chat. It said he had won free game coins and needed to claim them before the offer ended. The message showed the game’s logo and included a shortened link. It asked Rafi to enter his full name, school, phone number, and account password. The sender’s account was unfamiliar. Rafi wanted the reward, but he did not open the link or send any details. Instead, he opened the game’s official website using a bookmark he had saved earlier. He found no announcement about a reward. He then showed the message to his older sister and used the game’s report tool. Rafi could not confirm that the offer was real, so he kept his information private.

questions.prompt: What is the passage mainly about?
choices: How Rafi responded safely to a suspicious game message.
How to earn more coins in an online game.
Why every game should offer free rewards.
How Rafi created a new game account.
questions.explanation: Keseluruhan bacaan berfokus pada pesan hadiah yang mencurigakan dan keputusan Rafi untuk tidak memberikan data, memeriksa situs resmi, serta melaporkannya.

choices: Bagaimana Rafi merespons pesan hadiah permainan yang mencurigakan dengan aman.
Cara memperoleh lebih banyak koin dalam permainan daring.
Mengapa setiap permainan harus menawarkan hadiah gratis.
Bagaimana Rafi membuat akun permainan baru.

questions.evidence: Rafi wanted the reward, but he did not open the link or send any details.

questions.prompt: Which combination is a warning sign in the message?
choices: A saved bookmark and an official website.
A shortened link, an unfamiliar sender, and a request for personal details.
A message from a known teacher.
A notice published on the game’s official website.
questions.explanation: Tautan yang dipersingkat, akun pengirim yang tidak dikenal, dan permintaan nama lengkap, sekolah, nomor telepon, serta kata sandi merupakan tanda yang patut dicurigai.

translationId.prompt: Kombinasi mana yang menjadi tanda peringatan dalam pesan tersebut?
choices: Penanda halaman yang tersimpan dan situs resmi.
Tautan yang dipersingkat, pengirim yang tidak dikenal, dan permintaan rincian pribadi.
Pesan dari guru yang dikenal.
Pengumuman yang diterbitkan di situs resmi permainan.

questions.evidence: The message showed the game’s logo and included a shortened link. It asked Rafi to enter his full name, school, phone number, and account password. The sender’s account was unfamiliar.

questions.prompt: Why did Rafi use a saved bookmark to open the game’s official website?
choices: To send his password to the sender.
To claim the reward before the offer ended.
To check the offer without using the message’s link.
To find the sender’s private account.
questions.explanation: Penanda halaman yang telah disimpan membuka alamat yang sudah dikenal. Rafi dapat memeriksa pengumuman tanpa memakai tautan dari pesan yang belum terverifikasi.

translationId.prompt: Mengapa Rafi menggunakan penanda halaman yang tersimpan untuk membuka situs resmi permainan?
choices: Untuk mengirim kata sandinya kepada pengirim.
Untuk mengambil hadiah sebelum penawaran berakhir.
Untuk memeriksa penawaran tanpa menggunakan tautan dari pesan.
Untuk menemukan akun pribadi pengirim.

questions.evidence: Instead, he opened the game’s official website using a bookmark he had saved earlier.

questions.prompt: What did Rafi do after he found no announcement about a reward?
choices: He entered his account password.
He forwarded the link to his classmates.
He replied to ask for more coins.
He showed the message to his sister and used the report tool.
questions.explanation: Setelah tidak menemukan pengumuman, Rafi menunjukkan pesan kepada kakaknya dan menggunakan fitur pelaporan permainan. Ia tidak membagikan data atau meneruskan tautan.

translationId.prompt: Apa yang dilakukan Rafi setelah tidak menemukan pengumuman tentang hadiah?
choices: Ia memasukkan kata sandi akunnya.
Ia meneruskan tautan kepada teman sekelas.
Ia membalas pesan untuk meminta lebih banyak koin.
Ia menunjukkan pesan kepada kakaknya dan menggunakan fitur pelaporan.

questions.evidence: He then showed the message to his older sister and used the game’s report tool.
